<fidel-form>

Form with drafts and offline sending. Wraps your <form>: saves a draft as you type, sends later when offline, never sends twice, and adds the error summary.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Anyone whose session times out or whose connection drops, and screen-reader users (every message is shown and said).

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት። This example has no api and no draft, so nothing is sent or stored.

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-form id="apply" sensitive="support">
  <form>
    <fidel-input label="Full name" name="fullName" required></fidel-input>
    <fidel-date label="Date you can start" name="startDate"></fidel-date>
    <button type="submit">Send</button>
  </form>
</fidel-form>

Source: player/src/components/forms/form.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-form>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
api, actionURLnoneAddress to POST the answers to as JSON (multipart with a file). Without it, the page gets fidel-form-submit.
sensitivecomma-separated namesnoneFields NEVER stored on the device. Files and passwords are never stored either.
draftoffonNo draft.
draft-keytextthe element's idStorage name (fidel-form-draft:<key>, fidel-form-outbox:<key>).
ui-langen, amthe page's langMessages of the form and every field inside.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-form>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-form-submit{ data, queued }Without api: the answers for the page. Call preventDefault() to show your own message.
fidel-form-sent{ data, status }With api: sent.
fidel-form-queued{ data }Kept for later (offline).
fidel-form-draft-saved{}Draft saved.
fidel-form-draft-restored{ data }Draft put back after a reload.

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • A second press while sending does nothing. "Draft saved", "Sent. Thank you." and "Saved on this phone. It will be sent when you are online." are shown and said.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Messages in English or Amharic (ui-lang), passed to every field inside.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 2.2.1 Timing Adjustable: A draft is put back after a reload or a session time-out.
  • 3.3.7 Redundant Entry: Answers are kept after a failed or offline send. Sensitive fields are not kept, by design.
  • 4.1.3 Status Messages: Draft saved, sent and saved offline are announced.

The full WCAG 2.2 AA conformance report
